contract.benchmark: actual regional swing central inputs; no exact output conditioning
contract.estimator: joint forward-summary minimum distance; not latent ML
contract.lambda: zero-centred; training lambda-estimate RMS; predictive df=training count; no variance normalization/deconvolution
contract.loadings: S^-1 J (I-hh^T/(h^Th)) B; B_nkj=(delta_kj-q_nk)*s_nj at party-j's own cluster
contract.nuisance: raw-unit least-squares lambda refitted after every full synthetic projection; then divide residual by lambda-zero share scale

optimizer.name: bounded finite-difference Gauss-Newton with backtracking
optimizer.resolution_probe_directions: axes and diagonals after no improving GN/backtracking step; complete probe required, independent of rejected direction size

contract.pair_seed: first 8 SHA256 hex digits of base-seed|input-hash
contract.reference: training Gaussian seat-MAD initial scale; no clusters; Gaussian training lambda RMS
contract.reference_sd: max(draw SD,0.001,0.05*abs(reference mean)); diagonal weights, not SEM
contract.rms_gate: each rank's actual four-fold RMS within 5th-95th predictive reference; preserve leader/runner pairing within fold

limitations: Retrospective leave-one-pair-out diagnostics: these elections already informed model design.
Actual regional swings are central inputs; simulated aggregate shares are not constrained to match them.
Summary minimum-distance fitting is not latent-variable maximum likelihood; numerical stability alone does not establish identification.
The lambda RMS construction treats fitted historical lambdas as latent draws; measurement-noise overlap is reported, not silently removed.
No runtime model, configuration, saved archive, release flag or database write is performed.

contract.limitations: Two fixed three-transition realizations, heuristic recovery guards; no confidence-coverage claim; optimizer and Monte Carlo stability remain required
